𝕱𝖑𝖔𝖗𝖆𝖓𝖎𝖆’s Website
The website aligns well with the brand, highlighting 𝕱𝖑𝖔𝖗𝖆𝖓𝖎𝖆’s creativity and missions. The website is 
bold and striking which is great for website stickiness. The usability on the site is great. To optimize 
the user experience I would shrink the size of the video and drawing to ﬁt the size on a screen on the 
main website page, rather than being bigger than the whole screen.

Leading Up to Fashion Week
Consistency is key. 
Creating a weekly posting 
schedule will ensure that 
customers are reminded of 
pieces they can buy, helping 
to build brand image and 
drive sales. Ensuring that 
posts are made for a 
reason and drive 
conversions is the biggest 
factor to building 
recognition. While I 
recommend three times a 
week, this can be modiﬁed 
depending on many factors

Final Recommendations
- Use more videos that feel personal (someone 
doing a outﬁt check in 𝕱𝖑𝖔𝖗𝖆𝖓𝖎𝖆)
- Utilize a consistent posting schedule, even 
during off seasons
- Make small changes to the website to help 
with aesthetics and readability
- Explore inﬂuencers in different regions to 
make user-generated content
- Utilizing a Linktree in every social media’s 
bio’s to create more consumer touchpoints
- Explore content schedulers for socials
